title: Long indicator text can overflow bounding box and overlap into adjacent icons inside System Tray
line: Long keyboard layout names like "latam" now shrink to fit their System Tray spot instead of running into the icons next to them.
explanation: The Keyboard Layout label uses Text.Fit to shrink its text into a square cell, but Qt never shrinks fitted text below minimumPointSize, which defaults to 12pt. In the System Tray with small icons the cell is too small for a 5-letter name at 12pt, so "latam" overflowed into the neighbouring icons. The change sets minimumPointSize to 1 so the text always shrinks to the cell.

commits.message:
applets/keyboardlayout: let the label shrink to fit small cells

With small System Tray icons a long layout name like "latam" stayed at
Qt's default minimum of 12pt for fitted text, so it ran into the icons
next to it. Lower the minimum so the label always shrinks to its cell.

BUG: 476542

patches.diff:
From a7f3dc1ce8a4d64d7c28664c64982085a064113e Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 03:26:11 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/keyboardlayout: let the label shrink to fit small
 cells

With small System Tray icons a long layout name like "latam" stayed at
Qt's default minimum of 12pt for fitted text, so it ran into the icons
next to it. Lower the minimum so the label always shrinks to its cell.

BUG: 476542
---
 applets/keyboardlayout/qml/main.qml | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/applets/keyboardlayout/qml/main.qml b/applets/keyboardlayout/qml/main.qml
index 7d955e64bc..273da0b95e 100644
--- a/applets/keyboardlayout/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/keyboardlayout/qml/main.qml
@@ -113,6 +113,7 @@ PlasmoidItem {
 
             font.pointSize: height || Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont.pointSize
             fontSizeMode: Text.Fit
+            minimumPointSize: 1
             horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
             verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
             text: switcher.layoutNames.displayName || switcher.layoutNames.shortName
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Tray with layout latam: the label runs into the Wi-Fi and brightness icons
Same tray: the label shrinks to fit its own cell

review.text: Text.Fit stops at Qt's 12pt default minimumPointSize, so lowering it is exactly the cause and the smallest fix; short labels are unaffected. The after shot shows 'latam' inside its cell. Very long names will get tiny text, but that is preferable to overlapping neighbours.
